en.headline: AFCD arrests owner of large dog that killed two small pets in Yuen Long
en.dek: The 60 kg dog had been detained in July over a previous attack and returned after a warning; the department is investigating both cases and may prosecute.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department arrested the keeper of a large dog involved in attacks on other dogs in Yuen Long on Monday afternoon. The dog, weighing about 60 kilograms, fatally attacked a 17-year-old miniature poodle and a four-year-old bichon frise near YOHO Mall on 17 August. It is now under observation at an AFCD animal management centre.

The department said the same dog had been detained on 10 July in connection with another dog-attack case and was later reclaimed by its keeper. At that time the AFCD warned that the dog must be securely held on a leash not exceeding two metres in public places and kept under proper control.

AFCD is investigating both incidents and will prosecute if there is sufficient evidence. Under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation, a large dog weighing 20 kg or more must be securely leashed in public places; offenders face a fine of HK$25,000 and three months’ imprisonment. The department reminded all keepers to keep dogs under proper control at all times.

zh.headline: 漁護署拘捕元朗咬斃兩小狗大狗飼主
zh.dek: 涉事約60公斤大狗曾於7月因另一咬傷案被扣留後發還，署方正調查兩案，如證據足夠將檢控。
body: 漁農自然護理署星期二下午拘捕元朗一宗狗隻襲擊其他狗隻案件中涉事大狗的畜養人，並錄取口供。涉事大狗重約60公斤，星期一在元朗YOHO附近先後咬死一隻17歲迷你貴婦狗及一隻4歲比熊犬，現正於署方動物管理中心接受觀察。
署方表示，涉事狗隻曾於7月10日因涉及另一宗咬傷狗隻個案被扣留，其後由畜養人領回。當時漁護署已警告必須在公共地方使用長度不超逾2米的狗帶穩妥牽引，並對其作出適當控制。
漁護署正就兩宗案件進行調查，如有足夠證據將提出檢控。根據《危險狗隻規例》，體重20公斤或以上的大型狗隻在公眾地方須以長度不超逾2米的狗帶穩妥牽引，違例者可被判罰款25,000元及監禁3個月。署方再次提醒所有狗主時刻妥善管束狗隻。
